### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**21** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f72f335393f40e27194c56911e6de46052cb6f4c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `612c8df7eaabb91d71037b36af9058b5f4bbfb57` — the merge of head `022ffdfd80121895dba020055859236842bfc094` into base `f72f335393f40e27194c56911e6de46052cb6f4c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 612c8df7eaabb91d71037b36af9058b5f4bbfb57 && git checkout 612c8df7eaabb91d71037b36af9058b5f4bbfb57
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f72f335393f40e27194c56911e6de46052cb6f4c 022ffdfd80121895dba020055859236842bfc094 && git checkout -B drift-repro f72f335393f40e27194c56911e6de46052cb6f4c && git merge --no-ff 022ffdfd80121895dba020055859236842bfc094

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f72f335393f40e27194c56911e6de46052cb6f4c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#6 · head `022ffdfd80121895dba020055859236842bfc094`

- Shape: draft → main, `Fixes #38029`, four files in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` plus a patch changeset.
- Premise measured on main `815e882b` (after #38028) by the dev (report 7232213655): with `emailAndPassword.enabled: false` declared and nothing stored, `SettingsService.get` and `GET /api/settings/auth` answer `{ value: true, source: 'default' }` while `getPublicConfig().emailPassword.enabled` is false.
- Diff read by the seat: a `registerLiveStatus('auth', …)` provider (the seam `plugin-email` uses for `mail`), optional on the structural settings surface, registration failure logged not thrown; it awaits the settings pass a change event started, then `describeEmailPasswordLiveStatus` compares the shown value with the running one: agreement states nothing; declared off with nothing stored is `info`; held off by the host (`emailPasswordHeldOffByHost`, #38028's predicate) is `info`, `warning` over a stored on; any other disagreement is `warning`. Copy in all 11 locales, composed per request. Resolved `values`, saves and the managed save door unchanged.
- Declarations: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch. The banner rides the existing `live_status` payload shape; no published schema or governed path touched, so no contract review is owed (same reading as 7219466980 / the #38025 record).
- Tests: new real-plugin, real-settings-service, real-route file, 7 cases incl. CONTROL (declared on) and stored-value-wins both ways; reverse check on base failed exactly the two banner cases after the premise assertions passed. Package suite 296 files / 6305 passed.
- Gates: check-runs at head 37 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed; mergeable clean.
- Seat ruling on the dev's open question: A (banner) here; the switch showing the running value (option B, a runtime-declared default seam that redefines `source: 'default'`) is filed as #38098 for triage. The likely same gap on `signup_enabled` / `require_email_verification` is recorded there.
- Landing: `--land`.
